value.reply: Here's what I found near Springfield for Mia and Leo. Swim lessons for Mia, and a couple of free options that suit Leo too.
groupLeads: Swim lessons at the community pool for ages 3 to 5, on Saturdays at 10:00. Mia's age fits this one.
Free library storytime on Tuesdays at 10:30, open to all ages, so Leo can come too. There's also a free drop-in playgroup on weekday mornings for kids up to 6, which suits both of them.
